_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "organizations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "country_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "tr_registration_no" TEXT NULL, "tr_aks_no" TEXT NULL, "hive_count_range" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memberships" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "apiaries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "altitude_m" INTEGER NULL, "landowner_name" TEXT NULL, "landowner_phone" TEXT NULL, "land_tenure" TEXT NULL, "water_source" TEXT NULL, "vehicle_distance_m" INTEGER NULL, "road_notes" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((latitude IS NULL) = (longitude IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "queens" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "mark_color" TEXT NULL, "breed" TEXT NULL, "breed_line" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NULL, "mating_status" TEXT NULL, "wing_clipped" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("wing_clipped" IN (0, 1)), "mother_queen_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hives" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag_code" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "apiary_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "queen_id" TEXT NULL, "box_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "frame_count" INTEGER NULL, "source" TEXT NULL, "marking" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hive_location_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hive_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "apiary_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "moved_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inspections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hive_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "apiary_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "queen_state" TEXT NULL, "bee_frames" INTEGER NULL, "brood_frames" INTEGER NULL, "honey_frames" INTEGER NULL, "temperament" TEXT NULL, "swarm_signs" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("swarm_signs" IN (0, 1)), "queen_cells" TEXT NULL, "disease_suspected" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("disease_suspected" IN (0, 1)), "data" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inspection_drafts" ("hive_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "draft" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("hive_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inspection_reminders" ("inspection_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hive_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remind_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("inspection_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hive_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspection_id" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "storage_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "captured_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "byte_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_uploads" ("media_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "upload_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("media_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "record_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("record_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_pulled_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("record_table"));
CREATE INDEX memberships_org_id_idx ON memberships (org_id)
CREATE INDEX apiaries_org_id_idx ON apiaries (org_id)
CREATE INDEX queens_org_id_idx ON queens (org_id)
CREATE INDEX hives_org_id_idx ON hives (org_id)
CREATE INDEX hives_apiary_id_idx ON hives (apiary_id)
CREATE INDEX hive_location_history_org_id_idx ON hive_location_history (org_id)
CREATE INDEX hive_location_history_hive_id_idx ON hive_location_history (hive_id)
CREATE INDEX inspections_org_id_idx ON inspections (org_id)
CREATE INDEX inspections_hive_id_idx ON inspections (hive_id)
CREATE INDEX media_org_id_idx ON media (org_id)
CREATE INDEX media_hive_id_idx ON media (hive_id)
